column1: # Baltic Sea OSMOSE configuration - Main parameter file
# EXPERIMENTAL — cod E/W disaggregation (2026-07-25). NOT a production/calibrated
# config. Cod is split into cod_west (sp0) + cod_east (sp8) as 9 focal species.
# The 9-species model could NOT be fitted to the ICES envelopes: suppressing the
# eastern cod removes apex predation and releases the prey field 10-80x over
# envelope (best re-cal obj 8.855 vs the aggregate baseline's 2.33). Running this
# config yields non-physical biomass. For the working model, restore the 8-species
# 9 focal species: Cod_west, Herring, Sprat, Flounder, Perch, Pike-perch, Smelt, Stickleback, Cod_east
# 6 LTL resource groups: Diatoms, Dinoflagellates, Microzooplankton, Mesozooplankton, Macrozooplankton, Benthos
